title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized storage to your shower with this wall mount oval combination shower basket crafted from solid brass and ventilated wire for drainage. Designed for traditional bathroom hardware looks, it helps keep bottles and soap within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction with rust-proof solid brass wires for long-lasting use
- Wall-mounted installation to keep shower items off ledges and corners
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Available in a wide variety of designer finish options, including statement colors
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Category: Basket
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H (Projection: 4.13-Inch)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
